violation_type.title: Activities for School-age - Provides Thinking Skills and Sensory Development (26 TAC §746.2707(3))
violation_type.short_title: Activities for School-age - Provides Thinking Skills and Sensory Development
violation_type.typical_finding: In the school-age classroom, a wide variety of toys that meet age-appropriate expectations was observed.

finding_variants.text: In the school-age classroom, a wide variety of toys that meet age-appropriate expectations was observed.
The school aged classroom had no age appropriate activities.
The school aged classroom still had minimal age appropriate activities.  The only things present were the air hockey machine, construction paper and crayons.
